title: Algebra of Path Integrals on Digraphs
summary: In this paper, we extend the iterated path integrals from smooth manifolds to digraphs and develop the associated algebraic and geometric structures. Iterated path integrals on a digraph naturally give rise to the iterated path algebra and the iterated loop algebra, both defined as quotient algebras of a shuffle algebra, with the latter carrying a canonical Hopf algebra structure.
